cohort: 1125 singleton pregnancies conceived through IVF and 7193 singleton pregnancies conceived spontaneously, from a single tertiary infertility center in Asia
finding: ART was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes, pregnancy-induced hypertension, abruption, chorioamnionitis, and caesarean delivery, but a decreased risk of oligohydramnios.
mod_finding: IVF significantly increases the risk of abruption by 2 times (p=0.028), and independently increases the risk of caesarean section by 3.1-fold (p<0.001).
